note: The software of the Oct 9 fleet image (nt-agents-2026-v3, copied as zab-fleet-20261009), which push_config.py installs as /etc/zab/tools.json where an image has none (#475; tools_list.py). Versions come from workshop/ami/build.sh's pins, docs/DECISIONS.md, workshop/ami/files/julia/Manifest.toml and Ubuntu 24.04's archive (each entry's source); none is guessed, so some are empty. `unverified` marks what the image build's smoke test didn't run: the Sage environment's programs other than sage itself, and FLINT. `requires` lists the paths that must all exist on a VM for the entry to be installed there. `with` holds an entry's fields for a feature the rollout found on the VM (`sage-wrapper`: ~agent/.local/bin/sage is the image's wrapper, #482; sage_wrapper.py). `note`, `source`, `requires` and `with` are left out of the installed file.
